Recommendations

Dreamerror2026-09-15
Google Ads import probe fails because it runs from the wrong python (163x this week)
The recurring 'import google.ads.googleads.v21' failure is an interpreter mismatch, not a broken integration. Base python3 on this box has no 'google' package, so the probe exits 1 every time (163 occurrences this window). The official client IS installed and imports cleanly (v21 and v25 both OK) in venvs/google-ads/bin/python. The verified live pull path is the v25 REST searchStream, and the pip client is only a fallback. Fix: point agents at venvs/google-ads/bin/python (or the REST path) instead of base python, and state the venv interpreter path in the google-ads-api skill so no future session re-derives it by trial.
venvs/google-ads/bin/python -c 'import google.ads.googleads.v25; print("v25 client OK")'
20 min/mo
Why we're suggesting this (3)
  • base probes: 'No module named google' when run under python3 (verified live)
  • venvs/google-ads/bin/python -c 'import google.ads.googleads.v25' -> OK (verified live)
  • 163 terminal exit-1 error occurrences with the googleads.v21 import command in the last 7-day window
